entries.summary: Fixed pacing mode bug where 'All' pace paused like 'Section' pace; now properly skips section-level and doc-level pauses when 'all' is selected

Add git worktree support to kickoff and branch scripts: every kickoff/branch now creates a linked worktree so parallel workstreams don't stomp on each other's checked-out branch. Added get_registry_root/get_registry_dir to route registry I/O to the primary worktree.

Complete partition-acceptance: machine-testable partition specs (AC, Artifact Type, How to Run in approach.md template + emergence guidance) and typed event log infrastructure (emit_event.py, get_events.py, lifecycle script integration, utils.emit, status display, implementation Rules 9-10, SKILL.md Event Log section). 251 tests.

Added machine-testable partition specs (Artifact Type, How to Run, Acceptance Criteria in approach.md) and typed event log infrastructure (emit_event.py, get_events.py, utils.emit). All lifecycle scripts now emit events; implementation agents emit task.complete and partition.complete per Rules 9-10.
Add spec front matter indexes, reset-boundary guidance, canon-summary routing hints, and regression checks for compact context reloads.
Adaptive repo classification, bootstrap V3 canon planning, and targeted reconcile landed on master.
Add optional code graph foundation with SQLite storage, explicit build/status commands, seeded area loading, and foundation tests.
Add graph query commands for area, neighbors, tests, callers, callees, route, and signature-impact with Python-backed semantics and explicit analyzer coverage.
Add local graph usage logging, end-to-end timing, filterable usage reports, and observability resilience tests.
Integrate optional graph guidance across the Cicadas skill, emergence modules, routing templates, and top-level docs while keeping graph usage conditional.
Reduced scan-repo peak memory by streaming repo-tree.jsonl entries during inventory build and added regression coverage proving incremental spool-to-disk behavior.

Exclude SDD installs (SKILL.md detection), SDD state dirs (substring match on root-level ./_ prefixed dirs for bmad/cicadas/gsd/openspec), and config-declared scan_exclude_paths from scan_repository traversal
Add initiative profiles with Technical Brief and Operator Experience guidance, templates, tests, and docs.
Fix review findings 1-7: init preservation, safe synthesis apply, deterministic git tests, graph linked-test streaming, token log locking, active-dir naming, and module path containment.
